name: MAX31865
title: RTD (PT100/PT1000) to digital converter, SPI, 15-bit, 2/3/4-wire
titleRu: Преобразователь сигнала термосопротивления PT100/PT1000 в цифру, SPI, 15 бит, 2/3/4 провода

pins.name: VIN
pins.desc: 3-5 V, feeds the onboard 3.3 V regulator

notes: Set RREF and RNOMINAL to match the board: 430 ohm / 100 for PT100, 4300 ohm / 1000 for PT1000.
Adafruit board is 4-wire by default; for 2- or 3-wire probes solder the jumpers on the back and pass MAX31865_2WIRE/3WIRE to begin().
VIN takes 3-5 V and SPI pins are level-shifted, so power it at your MCU logic level.
Fault code 0x… from readFault() usually means a disconnected probe or wrong wire-mode jumpers.
